detail: The full app is live on Render Free over HTTPS. All nine hosted smoke checks passed, including private sign-in, cross-account isolation, semantic document import, a real photo job and OpenAI RAG styling. The single hosted photo job took 5.52 s after enqueue; one styling request took 11.08 s and returned two valid owned outfits. These are deployment checks, not population latency estimates.
finalChange: CSS-only garment caption clipping fix; backend unchanged from hosted smoke checks.
